aboutText: Based in Glen Huntly, Serhii brings European-trained expertise to every tiling project. With over 10 years of hands-on experience in kitchens, bathrooms, and floors, he delivers clean finishes and honest work. Whether it's a small splashback or a full renovation, Serhii treats every job like it's in his own home, using high-quality materials for lasting results.
servicesText: At Serhii Dovhan Your Tiler, we specialise in tiling for kitchens, bathrooms, and all floor types. Our services include splashbacks, full renovations, and waterproofing, ensuring a professional finish every time. We use only high-quality materials and bring European craftsmanship to Glen Huntly.
